title: Giant Wilson loops from Fredholm determinants
summary: We study large-k symmetric and antisymmetric Wilson loops in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory. We represent their generating functions as Fredholm determinants built from the Hermite kernel weighted by a symbol function that encodes the representation. Using the integrable structure of the kernel, we systematically apply the Tracy-Widom approach to derive a closed system of integro-differential equations.
